summary: Black objects on left side attract toward grey vertical separator line; enclosed magenta regions adjacent to separator emit red rays rightward to grid edge.
src: black connected sprites on left side of grey separator s
path: translate s rightward until s.rightmost_column is adjacent to grey separator
multi_step: Step 1: translate black sprites rightward to be adjacent to grey separator; Step 2: identify enclosed magenta regions that touch separator; Step 3: emit red horizontal rays from those rows rightward to grid edge
src2: magenta pixels enclosed by black sprites that are exactly 1 cell left of grey separator s
path2: draw horizontal line rightward from corresponding position on right side of separator until grid.right_edge
trajectory2: paint red along entire horizontal line
